{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "zzzi2p",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACKed, but objected to 10 standby sessions as excessive resource usage and raised concerns about startup rate limiting"
    },
    {
      "login": "eyedeekay",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "supported the concept but objected to keeping a bank of 10 standby sessions as wasteful"
    },
    {
      "login": "mzumsande",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "raised concern that extra sessions expiring after 10 minutes would waste network resources"
    },
    {
      "login": "jonatack",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked whether the change only applies when inbound I2P connections are disabled"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "asked if author is still interested given months needing rebase and whether PR should be drafted"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:2725369358",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "a pool of 10 idle sessions doubles network resource usage",
      "quote": "10 standby sessions is a lot, except maybe at startup. If your I2P connections limit is 10, then you're doubling your network resource usage.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "reduced pre-created sessions to 1",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2732857665",
        "c:2737446144",
        "c:2740226777"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:2740226777",
      "status_by_quote": "reduce the pre-created sessions to 1, given the above."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2725369358",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "starting many sessions at once at startup could trigger router tunnel build rate limits",
      "quote": "The Java router has some tunnel build rate-limiting that may kick in.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained sessions are not created in a tight loop and showed startup timings",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2732857665"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:2732857665",
      "status_by_quote": "This PR is not going to create a storm of I2P sessions creation at startup because new session creation is not being done in a tight loop, deliberately."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2726907987",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "holding a bank of 10 sessions is wasteful unless demand rate requires it",
      "quote": "keeping a bank of 10 of them is pretty wasteful",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "reduced pre-created sessions to 1",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2732857665",
        "c:2737446144",
        "c:2740226777"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:2740226777",
      "status_by_quote": "reduce the pre-created sessions to 1, given the above."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:2695264617",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "extra sessions expire after 10 minutes and waste resources if not used before expiration",
      "quote": "If we don't use these extra sessions before they expire, their creation would be a waste of ressources.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "reduced pre-created sessions to 1",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2737446144",
        "c:2740226777"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:2737607630"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:2740226777",
      "status_by_quote": "reduce the pre-created sessions to 1, given the above."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:2695264617",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "fill the unused sessions buffer with connections right after startup when using -onlynet=i2p",
      "quote": "Maybe it could make a sense to fill the m_unused_i2p_sessions buffer with 4 connections right after startup?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that serial connection opening makes pre-creating just one session preferable",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2737446144",
        "c:2740226777"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:2737446144",
      "status_by_quote": "given that opening of new connections is done serially, one after another (not in parallel), and occasionally (except during startup) maybe it would be best to pre-create just one session?"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:2910454957",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "whether this change only applies when a node is configured with -i2pacceptincoming=0",
      "quote": "If I understand correctly, this change is only for if a node is configured with -i2pacceptincoming=0 to not accept inbound I2P connections?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed because accepting inbound connections uses a single persistent session",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2922285775"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:2922285775",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes. That is because if it is accepting incoming connections (has a permanent listening I2P address) then there is just one I2P session which is associated with that address and that session is used for all incoming and outgoing connections."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:2725369358",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "supports decoupling session creation from use for anonymity",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Split zzzi2p's startup rate-limiting concern into a second part and recorded mzumsande's suggestion about startup session pre-filling. Dropped deleted comment c:2726286747 and added jonatack's question.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "rebase and confirmation of interest in continuing the PR",
      "id": "c:5710793906"
    }
  ]
}
